dsh-opencode-go

简体中文

**OpenCode Go subscription usage and multiple-account management** for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness), with convenient access to quotas, reset times, and account switching. DSH already supports OpenCode Go natively. This plugin focuses on usage inside conversations, managing multiple accounts, and dedicated model and settings controls. - **Independent Go and Free routes**: dynamically discover each gateway’s chat models, keep overlapping IDs, and edit them in separate settings tabs. The Free route is an explicit opt-in and is **off by default**; enable it in **Settings → OpenCode Go → Advanced settings → Free channel** before it registers, fetches its catalog, or appears in model pickers. - **Free rate-limit protection**: once enabled, honors upstream `Retry-After` and pauses new requests during cooldown. Shared Free quota/IP limits do not rotate Go accounts. - **Usage at a glance**: see usage beside the conversation input, then open the panel for five-hour, weekly, and monthly percentages and reset times. - **Accounts in one place**: inspect each account's quota and key status, drag to reorder, switch inside a conversation, or enable automatic fallback. - **Clearer model and settings controls**: search and filter models, adjust visibility, limits, and thinking budgets; advanced settings are grouped by purpose, with hints and a reset action. Supports Chinese and English, following DSH's interface language. The existing screenshots below show the Chinese **Classic** theme; the default **Native** theme follows the active DSH color, typography, and geometry tokens. ## View subscription usage Click the usage pill beside the conversation input to open the current account's subscription usage. Bars show the **percentage used**, turn amber near the limit, and red when exhausted. Each quota window shows its reset time. While visible, usage refreshes every minute. Periodic queries pause while the page is hidden and resume with a refresh when it becomes visible. Temporary failures show a warning; retained readings are marked as previous data. Click **Retry now** after a failure, or **Refresh accounts** in the Settings account card. Under **Settings → OpenCode Go → Advanced settings → Usage display**, choose: | Mode | Behavior | | --- | --- | | Auto (default) | Show while a **DSH OpenCode Go** model is selected | | Always | Also show configured OpenCode Go account usage while using other models | | Off | Hide the conversation pill and stop its polling | ## Usage analytics Open the dashboard from the conversation input's expanded usage pill or the sidebar dashboard button. ![Official workspace history dashboard with sample data](docs/assets/usage-history-desktop.jpg) [Narrow-screen light preview](docs/assets/usage-history-mobile.jpg) · [Model rankings and detail](docs/assets/usage-history-models.jpg), both using sample data. - **One official source**: totals, daily charts and model detail use the same official daily CSV, covering requests, input/output/cache tokens and the official usage amount. Models are grouped by provider + model. Ranges are today, 7, 30 and 90 days; all dates use UTC. - **Independent viewing account**: defaults to the current inference account and shows only the workspace belonging to the selected key, including calls from other clients. Changing the viewing account does not change the conversation account. All three dashboard quota windows follow the selection. Anonymous Free coverage is not guaranteed. - **Official usage amount**: sums `cost_micro_cents` directly (`1 USD = 100,000,000` units); it does not mean an additional Go charge. Official daily aggregates may be delayed. - **Two themes, shared layouts**: settings, the usage pill, sidebar and dashboard use the same component layouts. `appearanceTheme` selects **DSH Native (default)** or **OpenCode Go Classic**, with light/dark schemes following the Host; see [Grouped advanced settings](#grouped-advanced-settings) for the theme behavior. The dashboard becomes full-screen on narrow screens and retains daily token/request bars, model rankings and details. - **On-demand queries**: history loads when opening, changing account or range, or refreshing manually. The Host uses a 30-second cache; forced refresh bypasses it. History is not polled in the background. Only official model gateway configurations support it; errors remain explicit without falling back to local scans. Keys stay on the Host. Normal reports send the browser only aggregate numbers and provider / model / day; an official CSV explicitly downloaded by the user may contain member fields. See [usage analytics notes](docs/usage-analytics.en.md) for accounting and privacy details. ## Manage multiple accounts Open **Settings → OpenCode Go → Accounts** to manage accounts: ![Account management: ordering, usage details, key actions, and automatic fallback](docs/assets/accounts.png) - Add, rename, replace keys, or remove accounts; up to 20 accounts are supported. - See key status, five-hour usage, and a reset countdown in each row; expand it for full usage and account actions. - Drag a row's handle to reorder accounts. The first row becomes current, and the order determines automatic fallback priority. - Click **Switch** in the conversation usage panel to move the selected account first for subsequent requests in this profile. The other accounts keep their relative order. With **Automatic fallback** enabled, HTTP 401/403/429 or exhausted quota causes the plugin to try other accounts in order before output begins. A fallback account that starts producing output moves first and becomes current, and the usage panel shows a switch notice. Requests that have already produced output, recorded token usage, or been canceled are not automatically resent through another account. Gateway-rejected keys cool down in memory for five minutes. Account commands write credentials and settings through one serial host queue. Keys are saved through DSH's credential service. Settings never displays an already saved key. ## Free channel (opt-in, off by default) `DSH OpenCode Free` is not enabled by default. It is an explicit opt-in because it uses the upstream public Free entry point and sends requests as the official OpenCode CLI, which may violate upstream terms or trigger abuse controls. Enable it in **Settings → OpenCode Go → Advanced settings → Free channel** and save (or set `freeEnabled: true` in the profile patch). While it is off, the plugin does not register the `dsh-opencode-free` route, does not fetch `freeBaseURL`'s model catalog, and does not advertise Free models through discovery or the Settings model list. Turning the switch off later withdraws the route on the next settings update; requests already streaming are allowed to finish. Go behavior and account handling are unchanged. Once enabled: - **Saved-key reuse is endpoint-bound**: Free shares the account roster and follows the Automatic fallback setting, but only reuses saved keys when `freeBaseURL` is the official HTTPS endpoint (`opencode.ai` over `https:` on its default port) or shares the Go gateway's origin (same scheme, host and port, e.g. one self-hosted reverse proxy serving both routes). `http://opencode.ai`, an `opencode.ai` URL on a custom port, and any other custom `freeBaseURL` fall back to anonymous `Bearer public` — no saved key is read or sent — and the decision is logged without credentials. - **Anonymous public access without a key**: with no usable key it sends `Bearer public`. - **Official CLI identity**: requests use the official OpenCode CLI user agent (`opencode/latest/2.2.5/cli`) instead of DSH's own attribution. - **Separate Bun runtime**: Free inference runs in its own HTTP worker started from the official `@oven/bun-*` optional platform packages, all pinned to 1.4.4. These packages ship the native binary directly, with no `bun` wrapper or `postinstall`, so no Bun build-script approval is needed. Missing optional dependencies can produce `MISSING_BUN_RUNTIME` while Go keeps working (see the FAQ). - **Rate-limit protection**: honors upstream `Retry-After`; new calls during cooldown fail fast with `FREE_COOLDOWN`, and shared Free quota/IP limits never rotate Go accounts. > ⚠️ **Risk**: the Free channel relies on the upstream public Free access point and an impersonated client user agent. It may violate OpenCode/upstream terms of service and may trigger rate limiting, risk controls, or account restrictions. Use it only if you understand and accept that risk; it is not intended for production or large-scale automation. ## Install and get started Requires DSH `0.2.1-rc.5` or later. See [development](docs/development.md) for the current validation workflow. ### Install from DSH 1. Open **Plugins → Add plugin**. 2. Enter `dsh-opencode-go` and click **Install**. 3. Click **Enable now** after installation. ![Install the plugin in DSH](docs/assets/install-via-dsh.gif) You can also enter the repository URL: ```text https://github.com/Duskriver/dsh-opencode-go ``` Command-line installation: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-opencode-go ``` Start or restart `dsh web` after command-line installation. Web and Headless use separate profiles; install and update each individually. ### Get started 1. Open **Settings → OpenCode Go → Accounts**, click **Add account**, enter a name and your OpenCode Go subscription API key, and confirm. 2. Select a model under **DSH OpenCode Go** in the conversation model picker. 3. Start chatting and check usage beside the input. With multiple accounts, open the panel to switch. The plugin registers its own **DSH OpenCode Go** model provider. Selecting a native DSH provider does not automatically use this plugin's account switching. **Always** mode can still show usage for accounts configured in this plugin. ## Models and settings ### Select models and adjust parameters Search **Available models** by name or ID, or filter by **New in 7 days**, **Customized**, or **Deprecated**. Click **Refresh** to check the latest catalog. ![Model settings: search, filters, visibility switches, and parameter editing](docs/assets/model-settings.png) - Each model's switch controls its visibility in the conversation picker and takes effect immediately. - Select a model to inspect its catalog context window, maximum output, and input modalities. Save limit overrides to apply them; empty values use defaults. - Reasoning models offer the applicable switch, effort, or token budget options. Budget-based models also accept custom budgets that become available after saving. Any model with an output capacity above **65,536 tokens** defaults to that allowance when neither the caller nor settings specifies one. Smaller models retain their SDK defaults. DSH receives the same allowance for compaction budgeting. Set a model’s **Max output** override when a longer answer is needed. Streaming, reasoning, tool calls, and image input depend on model capabilities. Input modalities shown in Settings come from online model metadata; this plugin currently converts and forwards only image attachments. ### Grouped advanced settings Advanced settings are grouped into **Usage settings**, **Connection**, **Cache and timeouts**, and **Image handling**. Hover over a question mark for help. **Reset all to defaults** clears the card's custom overrides; save to apply the reset. The current account selection is preserved. Under **Usage settings → Appearance**, set `appearanceTheme` to `native` or `classic`. **Native (default)** follows DSH and third-party themes through public Host semantic tokens for colors, fonts, radii, shadows and focus styling, with neutral fallbacks when a Host token cannot be resolved. Its strong control boundary and state-derived chart series (output, cache read, cache write) stay on plugin-owned contrast-checked values instead of the Host palette: the Host's `border-l2` is a hairline divider and its `state-*` values are status-dot colors, neither guaranteed at the WCAG 1.4.11 3:1 that control boundaries and data-viz series need. The brand-accent chart series still follows the Host accent. Existing profiles without this field also default to Native. **Classic** retains warm paper / charcoal surfaces, terracotta accents, and preferred Anthropic Serif / Sans / Mono fonts with system and CJK serif fallbacks; Host and third-party themes do not override these brand tokens, while the Host's light/dark mode still selects the Classic scheme. **Input quota style** remains `badge` (default) or `plain`, and **Show quota in the sidebar** remains an independent switch, off by default. ![Advanced settings: grouped controls, hints, and a shared reset action](docs/assets/advanced-settings.png) HTTP, HTTPS, and SOCKS5 proxies are supported. After saving, subsequent conversations, catalog updates, and usage queries use the proxy. Connections originate from the machine running DSH; on a remote deployment, `127.0.0.1` refers to that server. Set `baseURL` and `freeBaseURL` independently under Connection. Protocol selection follows the gateway model declaration. The **Free channel** switch is the explicit opt-in for the Free route (off by default); see [Free channel](#free-channel-opt-in-off-by-default) for behavior and risks. See the [advanced guide](docs/advanced.en.md) for account, model-key and disk-cache details. Screenshots illustrate the interface. Actual models, quotas, and timestamps depend on your account and the current online catalog. ## Updates and common questions Update to the latest npm release: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-opencode-go --latest ``` Restart `dsh web` and reload the page afterward. For desktop DSH, quit and reopen the application. Headless users should replace `web` with `headless`. The repository's default branch may contain changes not yet released to npm. **Why is usage hidden?** Auto mode shows it only for **DSH OpenCode Go** models. Check that the plugin is enabled, a key is configured, and the display mode is appropriate. Choose Always to show usage with other providers. **Where is DSH OpenCode Free?** The Free route is an explicit opt-in and is off by default. Enable it in **Settings → OpenCode Go → Advanced settings → Free channel** and save; only then does the plugin register the route, fetch its catalog, and show Free models. See [Free channel](#free-channel-opt-in-off-by-default) for behavior and risks. **Why does Free need a separate Bun runtime?** Free inference directly uses the official `@oven/bun-` optional packages, all pinned to 1.4.4. They carry native binaries without install scripts, so no `bun` `postinstall` approval is needed; the package manager installs only the runtime matching the current OS, CPU and libc. If optional dependencies are omitted with `--omit=optional` or cannot be installed, Free reports `MISSING_BUN_RUNTIME`; reinstall the plugin with optional dependencies enabled. Go is unaffected. Leaving Free disabled does not automatically omit this optional runtime download. **What if usage queries or account additions fail?** Retry in the usage panel or refresh usage in the account card. Account actions run in a serial host queue; unsuccessful operations can be retried. See [account operations and saving](docs/advanced.en.md#account-operations-and-saving). **What if a long conversation keeps returning 400?** Check the output allowance and context window in the error, then run `/compact` or lower that model's **Max output** before retrying. Explicit context overflow is passed to DSH's recovery mechanism; an unexplained 400 keeps its classification and includes troubleshooting guidance. Failed attempts without measured tokens omit zero usage so they do not report an empty context. **Why does an old conversation need its model selected again?** When upgrading from `0.1.16` or earlier, select **DSH OpenCode Go** again in existing conversations or Agent presets. Manual configurations use `provider: dsh-opencode-go`. **Which host is targeted?** The development baseline is DSH `0.2.1-rc.5`. Developer messages, dynamic tool additions/removals, and deferred tool loading are explicitly rejected; see [development and testing](docs/development.md). Uninstall: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-opencode-go ``` ## Architecture and verification The source is organized by domain: | Domain | Modules | | --- | --- | | Plugin composition, settings and contracts | `index.ts`, `config.ts`, `contracts.ts` | | Requests, model catalog and protocol conversion | `adapter.ts`, `catalog.ts`, `conversion.ts`, `google.ts`, `sdk-types.ts` | | Accounts, official quota, official CSV history and transport | `accounts.ts`, `analytics.ts`, `transport.ts` | | Browser registration and typed state | `client/index.ts`, `client/controller.ts` | | Host settings, account/model controls, usage and Native/Classic presentation | `client/Section.tsx`, `client/UsagePill.tsx`, `client/AnalyticsDialog.tsx`, `client/presentation.ts` | The `x-opencode-session` header carries a stable form of the conversation ID for gateway cache affinity: printable ASCII IDs pass through unchanged, and only non-printable or plugin-reserved IDs are hashed (sha256 + base64url); neither form contains message content. 为 [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 量身打造的 **OpenCode Go 专属接入与多账号管理插件**。 DSH 原生支持接入 OpenCode Go，但原生模式无法满足复杂的生产与日常开发需求（如多账号无感容灾、会话级 Prompt 缓存绑定、会话内实时额度透视等）。本插件基于 Cordis 微内核架构，在提供完整模型协议转换的同时，带来了流畅的客户端 UI 与企业级容灾体验。 文档中的现有界面截图展示 **Classic** 主题；默认的 **Native** 主题会跟随当前 DSH 的颜色、字体与几何 token。 --- ## ✨ 核心特性 - 🆓 **双路由动态模型目录（Free 默认为关闭的 opt-in）**：Go 与平台免费模型分别从各自网关的 `/models` 发现，保留同名模型；平台免费通道（Free）默认关闭，需在 **设置 → OpenCode Go → 高级设置 → 免费通道** 显式开启后才注册路由、拉取目录并出现在模型选择器中；两套模型开关与容量设置独立。 - 🛑 **免费通道限流保护**：遵循上游 `Retry-After`，冷却期间暂停新请求；共享免费额度或 IP 限制不会触发 Go 换号。 - 🛡️ **多账号无感容灾**：支持最多 20 个账号集中管理与拖拽排序。当主账号额度耗尽或 Key 失效时，**在输出前自动尝试备用账号**，成功后自动扶正，告别“聊到一半额度没了”的打断感。 - ⚡ **会话级 Prompt 缓存绑定**：严格遵循网关协议注入专有 `x-opencode-session` 路由头，稳定复用网关上下文缓存，显著降低响应首字延迟。 - 📊 **会话内额度实时透视**：在聊天输入框旁常驻“用量胶囊”，直观展示 5 小时滚动、每周、每月的额度百分比及重置时间倒计时；支持休眠节能与静默刷新。 - **三窗口精准监控**： - 🟢 **5 小时滚动配额**：短周期高频使用的健康度。 - 🟡 **每周配额**：本周累计使用进度。 - 🔴 **每月配额**：月度套餐消耗百分比。 每个窗口均显示精确的重置倒计时；进度条会随着接近上限变黄，耗尽时变红。 - **节能与防抖机制**：默认每分钟静默刷新；当页面切入后台或浏览器最小化时**自动暂停轮询**，切换回前台时即时刷新。 - **账号全名与快速切换**：多账号时直接显示当前账号全名（名字过长以省略号截断），展开面板点击“切换”即可直接提拔目标账号为主账号。 - **显示模式**（在 **高级设置 → 额度显示** 中配置）： - **自动（默认）**：仅在使用 DSH OpenCode Go 模型时显示。 - **常驻**：切换到其他厂商模型时，仍然保持胶囊显示。 - **关闭**：隐藏胶囊并停止后台用量轮询。 ### 3. 官方历史用量看板（Analytics） 从对话输入框的用量胶囊展开面板，或侧栏的看板按钮打开： ![新版官方历史用量看板，示例数据](docs/assets/usage-history-desktop.jpg) [窄屏浅色预览](docs/assets/usage-history-mobile.jpg) · [模型排行与明细预览](docs/assets/usage-history-models.jpg)（均为示例数据） - **官方 CSV 单一来源**：请求、输入 / 输出 / 缓存 Token、官方用量金额、每日图表与模型明细来自同一份官方每日 CSV；provider + model 区分同名模型。支持今日、7 / 30 / 90 天，日期统一使用 UTC。 - **独立查看账号**：默认当前调用账号，只查看所选 Key 所属工作区，包含其他客户端；切换查看账号不改变对话账号。看板的三个额度窗口跟随所选账号。匿名 Free 覆盖不作保证。 - **复用已存账号（受端点绑定约束）**：Free 与 Go 共用账号列表，但只有在 `freeBaseURL` 是官方 HTTPS 端点（hostname 为 `opencode.ai`、协议为 `https:` 且使用默认端口），或与当前 `baseURL` 同 origin（协议 + 主机 + 端口完全一致，例如自建反向代理同时承载两个路由）时，才会复用已存账号 Key 并遵循“自动使用备用账号”设置；`http://opencode.ai`、自定义端口的 `opencode.ai` 以及其它自定义 `freeBaseURL` 一律退回匿名公共访问（`Bearer public`），不读取也不发送任何已存 Key，并记录不含密钥的诊断信息。 - **无 Key 时匿名公共访问**：没有可用 Key 时以 `Bearer public` 发起匿名公共访问。 - **官方 CLI 身份**：请求以官方 OpenCode CLI 的 `opencode/latest/2.2.5/cli` User-Agent 发出，而不是 DSH 自身的归属 UA。 - **独立 Bun 运行时**：Free 推理通过 `optionalDependencies` 中版本锁定为 1.4.4 的官方 `@oven/bun-*` 平台包启动独立 HTTP worker。平台包直接提供原生二进制，不需要 `bun` 包装包或其 `postinstall`，因此无需批准 Bun 构建脚本；缺少可选依赖时的表现见下方 FAQ。 - **限流保护**：遵循上游 `Retry-After`，冷却期间新请求直接返回 `FREE_COOLDOWN`；共享免费额度 / IP 限制不会触发 Go 换号。 > ⚠️ **风险提示**：Free 通道依赖上游公开的免费入口并以官方 CLI 身份发出请求，可能违反 OpenCode / 上游服务条款，也可能触发上游风控、限流或账号限制。是否开启以及使用频度由你自行判断并承担风险；请勿在生产环境或大规模自动化调用中使用。 --- ## 🛠️ 架构设计与工作原理 源码按领域组织，宿主与浏览器通过 DSH Typert RPC 通讯： ```text src/ ├── index.ts + config.ts 插件挂载、configure 设置与热更新 ├── contracts.ts 浏览器可用的配置、模型与 RPC 契约 ├── adapter.ts 请求执行、会话头、容灾与冷却 ├── catalog.ts 模型目录与公共元数据缓存 ├── conversion.ts 上下文、单次请求图片预算、回放与流转换 ├── google.ts + sdk-types.ts Google SDK 接入与公开类型 ├── accounts.ts 串行账号命令、凭据写入与官方配额 ├── analytics.ts 官方每日 CSV、历史聚合与短缓存 ├── transport.ts HTTP/HTTPS/SOCKS5、超时与脱敏错误 └── client/ ├── index.ts + controller.ts configForms 接入、类型化草稿与账号操作 ├── Section.tsx 宿主设置页、账号卡片与模型编辑器 ├── UsagePill.tsx 会话额度胶囊 ├── AnalyticsDialog.tsx 官方历史用量看板 └── presentation.ts 多语言、Native / Classic 主题 token 与显示格式 ``` 账号操作在内存串行队列中直接更新凭据与设置。模型容量草稿始终保留为对象；图片按单次请求限制数量、编码字节及最多四路并行准备。宿主仅使用 DSH `0.2.1-rc.5` 起提供的设置与图片卸载接口。包的 `.` 与 `./client` 导出路径保持不变。 ### 为什么必须要携带 `x-opencode-session`？ OpenCode Go 网关具有会话粘性路由与上下文缓存共享能力。插件会把 DSH 对话 ID 规范化为稳定的 `x-opencode-session` 请求头：常见的可打印 ASCII 会话 ID **原样透传**，只有包含非常规字符（非可打印 ASCII）或恰好占用插件内部保留前缀的 ID 才会做 sha256 + base64url 单向散列；两种形式都不含对话正文。目的只是让多轮对话始终落在同一推理节点上，最大化命中网关的 Prompt Cache，显著节省思考与生成时间。 --- ## ⚙️ 模型自定义与高级配置 ### 模型参数覆盖 进入 **设置 → OpenCode Go → 可用模型**： ![模型设置：搜索、分类筛选、显示开关和参数编辑](docs/assets/model-settings.png) - **显示开关**：自由隐藏不常用的模型，净化聊天选择器。 - **容量与上下文覆盖**：可手动指定上下文窗口（Context Window）与单次最大输出 Token。 - **思考预算（Thinking Budget）**：对支持深度思考的模型，可自定义思考强度等级或 Token 预算。 - **默认输出预算**：任意模型声明的输出上限超过 65,536 且调用方与设置均未显式指定时，默认封顶 **65,536 tokens**；较小模型保留 SDK 默认值。该预算同时报告给 DSH，用于上下文压缩。 ### 分组高级设置 支持在 **设置 → OpenCode Go → 高级设置** 中按需微调： ![高级设置：分组配置、提示入口和统一恢复默认](docs/assets/advanced-settings.png) - **界面主题**：在 **用量设置 → 外观** 中将 `appearanceTheme` 设为 `native` 或 `classic`。**Native（默认）** 通过 Host 公开语义 token 跟随 DSH 与第三方主题的颜色、字体、圆角、阴影和焦点样式，token 不可解析时使用中性 fallback；其中强控件边界与图表状态系列（输出 / 缓存读 / 缓存写）保持插件自有的对比度受控色值，不跟随 Host 或第三方调色板——Host 的 `border-l2` 是发丝分隔线、`state-*` 是状态点色，都不保证控件边界与图表所需的 WCAG 1.4.11 3:1；品牌强调色图表系列仍跟随 Host 强调色。未设置该字段的旧配置也缺省使用 Native。**Classic** 保留暖纸 / 炭灰、陶土色强调与 Anthropic Serif / Sans / Mono、中文衬线回退，不跟随 Host 或第三方主题覆盖这些品牌 token，但仍按宿主明暗模式切换 Classic 配色。输入栏额度样式仍为 `badge`（默认）/ `plain`，侧栏额度显示仍是独立开关且默认关闭。 - **网络代理**：支持填入 HTTP、HTTPS 或 SOCKS5 代理地址（如 `socks5://127.0.0.1:1080`），保存后即时应用于对话、用量查询与模型刷新。 - **超时控制**：分别支持配置请求准备超时（`requestPreparationTimeoutMs`）、整轮请求超时（`requestTimeoutMs`）以及流空闲看门狗阈值（`streamIdleTimeoutMs`）。 - **免费通道（opt-in）**：默认关闭；开启后注册 `DSH OpenCode Free` 路由、拉取平台免费模型；已存 Key 仅在 `freeBaseURL` 为官方域名或与 `baseURL` 同 origin 时复用，否则退回匿名公共访问；关闭后该路由撤回，进行中的请求允许完成。 - **一键恢复默认**：点击每张卡片的“全部恢复默认”可一键清空自定义覆盖，不影响已保存的账号 Key。 --- ## ❓ 常见问题 (FAQ)
Q: 为什么聊天输入区没有出现用量胶囊？ 1. 检查当前会话选中的模型是否为 **DSH OpenCode Go** 分组下的模型。默认“自动”模式仅在选择本插件模型时展示；若希望在使用其他模型时也看到配额，可在 **高级设置 → 额度显示** 中切为“常驻”。 2. 检查是否已在设置中填入有效 API Key 且插件已处于启用状态。
Q: 为什么在模型选择器里找不到 DSH OpenCode Free 模型？ Free 通道默认关闭（显式 opt-in）。请到 **设置 → OpenCode Go → 高级设置 → 免费通道** 打开开关并保存；只有开启后插件才会注册 Free 路由、拉取 Free 模型目录并在模型选择器中显示。Free 与 Go 共用账号，但请求会以官方 OpenCode CLI 的 User-Agent 发出，可能触发上游风控 / 限流，也可能违反上游条款，请自行评估并承担风险。
Q: Free 通道为什么需要额外的 Bun 运行时？ Free 推理直接使用 `optionalDependencies` 中版本锁定为 1.4.4 的官方 `@oven/bun-` 平台包启动独立 HTTP worker。平台包直接携带原生二进制，没有安装脚本，也不需要批准 `bun` 的 `postinstall`；包管理器只安装与当前系统、CPU 和 libc 匹配的运行时。若可选依赖被 `--omit=optional` 省略或未能安装，Free 会报 `MISSING_BUN_RUNTIME`，重新安装插件并启用 optional dependencies 即可恢复；Go 通道完全不受影响。Free 默认关闭并不会自动省略这项可选运行时下载。
Q: 为什么长会话中偶尔会报 400 错误？ 通常是因为单次上下文加输出预算超过了模型允许的 Context Window。建议： 1. 在会话中执行 `/compact` 指令压缩历史消息。 2. 或在 **可用模型** 设置中，适度调低该模型的“最大输出”上限。 明确的上下文超限错误会被插件捕获并交由 DSH 原生恢复机制处理。
Q: 升级插件后，旧会话找不到模型怎么办？ 从 `0.1.16` 及更早版本升级时，底层 Provider ID 进行了规范化统一。只需在旧会话或 Agent 配置的模型下拉框中，重新选择一次 **DSH OpenCode Go** 下的模型即可。
Q: 插件在执行过程中会自动将我的数据上传到第三方吗？ 正常对话会把请求内容发送到你配置的模型网关（默认为 OpenCode Go 官方网关），额度查询也会访问该网关。插件从 Go 与平台网关各自的 `/models` 下载公开的模型能力与价格；默认地址分别为 `https://opencode.ai/inference/go/v1` 与 `https://opencode.ai/inference/v1`。 历史看板由 Host 使用所选 Key 请求官方 Console 的每日 CSV，仅支持官方模型网关配置，沿用代理设置。浏览器常规报告只收到聚合数字与 provider / model / day，不含 Key、会话正文或成员字段；主动下载的官方 CSV 可包含成员字段。模型发现请求不携带会话正文、账号密钥或逐条统计记录。

# Security Policy

## 支持的版本

| 版本 | 支持状态 |
| --- | --- |
| 最新发布版本（`0.4.x`） | 接收安全修复 |
| 更早版本（`<= 0.1.x`） | 不再支持，请升级到最新版本 |

安全修复通常以补丁版本发布。无法升级的旧版本可能需要先迁移配置或凭据引用。

## 报告漏洞

请**不要**在公开 Issue 中披露漏洞细节、利用方式或任何真实凭据。

- 首选：通过 GitHub 的私密报告渠道——仓库 **Security → Report a vulnerability**（GitHub Security Advisory）。
- 若无法使用 Security Advisory：可以开一个**不含细节**的公开 Issue（仅说明“存在安全问题，需要私密沟通渠道”），维护者会建立后续私密沟通。
- 报告中请包含：受影响版本、DSH/Host 版本与操作系统、最小复现步骤、影响评估；如可能，附上修复建议。
- 请勿附带真实 API Key、代理用户名/密码、`Authorization` 头、会话正文或 `.credentials.yaml` 内容；确需展示时使用占位符替换。
- 维护者会确认收到、评估影响并协调修复与披露时间。本项目由社区维护，尽力而为，不提供 SLA。
- 范围：本仓库只覆盖 `dsh-opencode-go` 插件。DSH 本体（`@deepseek-ai/dsh*`）、OpenCode 网关或上游服务自身的问题，请报告给各自的维护方。

## 安全相关配置与行为

### 凭据

- OpenCode API Key 保存在 DSH 凭据服务中，不写入插件的 settings 文档；设置页不会回显已保存的密钥。
- 代理 URL 可携带用户名/密码：这些凭据会随代理连接发送给该代理；代理不可信时凭据可能暴露。插件错误信息会脱敏，但无法阻止代理自身记录流量。
- 不要在截图、日志、公开 Issue 或 CI 输出中粘贴 Key、代理密码或凭据文件内容。

### 网络与代理

- 支持 HTTP、HTTPS、SOCKS5 代理；代理运行在 DSH 所在机器上，远程部署时 `127.0.0.1` 指服务器自身。
- Free 的 SOCKS5 使用每请求专属的本机字节隧道与随机认证凭据；代理失败不会回退到直连。
- Free IPC 边界：单个请求体上限 64 MiB（读入前后各校验一次），base64 编码后的 worker 包上限 256 MiB；worker 另对 stdin 累计 256 MiB 做上限检查。

### Free 通道（默认关闭）

- Free 通道是显式 opt-in。开启后请求会以官方 OpenCode CLI 的 User-Agent 发往平台公共免费入口，可能违反上游条款，也可能触发风控、限流或账号限制；风险由使用者自行承担，不建议用于生产或大规模自动化。
- Free 通过版本锁定为 1.4.4 的官方 `@oven/bun-*` npm 可选平台包启动独立 worker。平台包直接提供原生二进制，不使用 `bun` 包装包或安装期脚本，因此不需要批准 Bun 的 `postinstall`；原生运行时仍属于上游供应链信任范围。若可选依赖不可用，Free 报 `MISSING_BUN_RUNTIME`，Go 通道不受影响。
- Free worker 以独立进程运行，并从显式环境 allowlist 启动，**不再继承宿主 `process.env`**：`NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS`、`NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED`、`NODE_OPTIONS`、`LD_PRELOAD`、`DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES` 以及代理环境变量不会传入 worker。依赖这些环境变量注入自定义 CA 或 TLS 覆盖的部署需要改用其他受支持方式，不要依赖该行为。

### 插件模型

- 本插件在 DSH Host 进程内以用户权限运行（DSH 插件模型不属于沙箱）；只安装可信任来源的插件。
- 工具调用、网络访问与文件访问的授权由 DSH 的沙箱与审批策略决定，插件不会绕过这些策略。

## Advanced usage

### Headless mode

Install the plugin:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile headless add dsh-opencode-go
```

Save this as `headless.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: agent-default-model
  config:
    provider: dsh-opencode-go
    model: deepseek-v4.1-flash
```

Enter your key in Bash or Zsh, then run a task:

```sh
read -s OPENCODE_API_KEY
export OPENCODE_API_KEY
dsh --profile headless --patch ./headless.patch.yml "Hello"
```

Replace `model` with an available model ID from Settings. See [examples/headless.patch.yml](../examples/headless.patch.yml).

### Network proxy

Open **Settings → OpenCode Go → Advanced settings → Proxy address**, enter a URL, and save. Examples:

```text
http://127.0.0.1:7890
socks5://127.0.0.1:1080
```

HTTP, HTTPS, SOCKS5, and URLs containing a username and password are supported. Subsequent conversations, catalog updates, and usage queries use the saved proxy. Connections originate from the machine running DSH; on a remote deployment, `127.0.0.1` refers to that server.

### Dual routes and manual configuration

`dsh-opencode-go` (DSH OpenCode Go) discovers all chat models from `baseURL/models` and activates when at least one usable API key is configured. `dsh-opencode-free` (DSH OpenCode Free) discovers only chat models with a valid declared tariff whose text input, output, cache and every context tier are all zero, from `freeBaseURL/models`. Missing or invalid prices never qualify as free. The Free route is an **explicit opt-in and off by default**: only after `freeEnabled` is enabled in **Settings → OpenCode Go → Advanced settings → Free channel** (or `freeEnabled: true` in the profile patch) does the plugin register the route, fetch the Free catalog and advertise Free models. The default configuration never contacts `freeBaseURL`. Turning the switch off withdraws the route on the next settings update; requests already streaming are allowed to finish. Go behavior is unchanged.

Saved-key reuse is endpoint-bound: Free shares the account roster, but only reuses saved keys when `freeBaseURL` is the official HTTPS endpoint (`opencode.ai` over `https:` on its default port) or shares the Go gateway's origin (same scheme, host and port, e.g. one self-hosted reverse proxy serving both routes); it then follows automatic account retry settings. `http://opencode.ai`, an `opencode.ai` URL on a custom port, and any other custom `freeBaseURL` fall back to anonymous public access (`Bearer public`): no saved key is read or sent, and a credential-free info/debug diagnostic is produced. Both routes preserve original model IDs, including overlapping names. Settings provides separate model tabs; Go keeps existing ID keys, while Free uses `dsh-opencode-free/<model ID>` in visibility and capacity settings.

> ⚠️ **Risk**: the Free channel is off by default and is not a supported stable capability. Once enabled it sends requests to the platform's public Free entry point while identifying as the official CLI, which may violate OpenCode/upstream terms of service and may trigger upstream risk controls, rate limits or account restrictions. Whether and how often to use it is your own decision and risk; it is not recommended for production or large-scale automation.

Free inference sends direct API requests through the bundled standalone Bun 1.4.4 HTTP worker, with no local OpenCode dependency. The existing Node SDK still handles discovery, message/tool conversion and response parsing; Go retains its transport. Free uses the observed `opencode/latest/2.2.5/cli` user agent and the existing host-session normalization (printable ASCII session IDs pass through unchanged; only non-printable or plugin-reserved IDs are sha256 + base64url hashed, and neither form contains message content), without placeholder tools or captured account/project/session values. Compatibility does not guarantee upstream free access.

Free requests handle rate limits automatically. `FreeUsageLimitError` becomes `FREE_QUOTA`, a generic 429 becomes `FREE_RATE_LIMIT`, an explicit OpenCode client restriction becomes `FREE_CLIENT_RESTRICTED`, and an otherwise unclassified 403 becomes `FREE_ACCESS_DENIED`. Go error codes and account switching retain their behavior. Explicit Go account quota/authentication failures on Free still follow existing account fallback settings; shared Free limits neither rotate accounts nor fall back to paid Go.

Shared Free restrictions and network, timeout or server errors honor `Retry-After` delta-seconds or HTTP-date, including delays of many hours. Without a valid header, exponential backoff starts at 60 seconds and caps at 15 minutes. Cooldowns are isolated by Free gateway and proxy configuration. New calls during cooldown return `FREE_COOLDOWN` without inference traffic; no automatic retry is scheduled. Users can retry after expiry; success resets the fallback counter. State is held in the plugin instance and starts fresh after restart.

Bun 1.4.4 installs through the plugin's direct `@oven/bun-<platform>` npm optional platform packages. These packages carry native binaries directly, without the `bun` wrapper or an install script, so pnpm does not request approval for a Bun `postinstall`. The package manager selects the package for the current OS, CPU and libc. If no runtime is available (for example `--omit=optional` or a failed install), Free reports `MISSING_BUN_RUNTIME`; reinstall with optional dependencies enabled. Go remains available. Leaving Free disabled does not automatically omit the optional runtime download. Supported operating systems and CPUs follow these official Bun platform packages.

Each Free HTTP request owns a worker, with at most four concurrent workers and cancellable queueing. Requests use stdin; response headers and raw SSE bytes use stdout. Keys never enter argv or temporary files. Consumer cancellation, timeouts and plugin unload stop requests and reap workers. Each request body is limited to 64 MiB and the encoded worker IPC packet to 256 MiB; the worker also enforces the stdin packet limit while reading. Bun handles HTTP/HTTPS proxies; SOCKS5 uses a per-request loopback byte tunnel with random authentication credentials, restricted to the request's own target host (case-insensitive, IP-normalized); its idle limit is the request's stream idle budget plus a 30-second margin (330 seconds by default), so a queued or large-context prefill stall is classified by the plugin's own stream watchdog first, while Bun still performs target TLS. A proxy failure never falls back to a direct connection.

Protocols, capabilities, reasoning controls and tariffs come directly from each gateway’s `/models` entries. Official gateways prefer declared protocol URLs; custom gateways keep their configured prefix. Separate `go.models.json` and `free.models.json` files under `~/.dsh/cache/dsh-opencode-go/` support ETag revalidation and offline retention. Cache documents identify their source URL and cannot be reused for another gateway.

The following patch configures shared accounts and per-model settings:

```yaml
- id: opencode-go
  config:
    apiKeyEnv: OPENCODE_API_KEY
    accounts:
      - id: primary
        name: Primary
        apiKeyEnv: OPENCODE_API_KEY
      - id: backup
        name: Backup
        apiKeyEnv: OPENCODE_GO_BACKUP_KEY
    autoSwitch: true
    # Free is off by default; opt in to the platform's free models
    # (same as Settings → Advanced settings → Free channel).
    freeEnabled: true
    freeBaseURL: https://opencode.ai/inference/v1
    proxyURL: http://127.0.0.1:7890
    refreshMinutes: 60
    modelVisibility:
      deepseek-v4-pro: false
    modelLimits:
      dsh-opencode-free/beam-free:
        maxTokens: 8192
      deepseek-v4.1-flash:
        maxTokens: 8192
      qwen3.7-plus:
        thinkingBudgets: [4096, 6000]
    maxImages: 30
```

Keep the options you need and supply the corresponding keys through DSH credentials or environment variables. The first entry in `accounts` is current; the remaining entries are tried in order. The legacy `apiKeyEnv` reference must match the first entry. Manual and automatic switches move the target account first while preserving the other accounts' relative order. Existing configurations retain their selected account by moving it first.

| Option | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `baseURL` | OpenCode Go gateway address; defaults to `https://opencode.ai/inference/go/v1`, with official inference endpoints selected by model protocol |
| `freeBaseURL` | Platform free gateway, default `https://opencode.ai/inference/v1`; editable with URL validation in advanced settings |
| `freeEnabled` | Explicit opt-in for the Free route, default `false`; only when `true` does the plugin register the Free route, fetch its catalog and discover Free models |
| `usageDisplay` | Usage display mode: `auto`, `always`, or `off` |
| `proxyURL` | Network proxy; an empty string uses the default network settings |
| `refreshMinutes` | Model catalog cache lifetime; defaults to 60 minutes, with manual refresh available in Settings |
| `modelVisibility` | Control model picker visibility by model ID |
| `modelLimits` | Per-model `contextWindow` and `maxTokens` overrides, plus additional `thinkingBudgets` options; null uses defaults |
| `maxImages` | Maximum images in one request's history; unset by default, with oldest images offloaded when exceeded |
| `streamIdleTimeoutMs` | Maximum wait for the next stream event; defaults to 300000 milliseconds |
| `requestPreparationTimeoutMs` | Deadline for discovery and each attempt's credential/image preparation; defaults to 60000 milliseconds |
| `requestTimeoutMs` | Whole dispatch deadline, including discovery, account fallback and streaming; defaults to 1800000 milliseconds. Prepared calls start this timer at dispatch |

Profiles that never set `freeEnabled` keep the default `false`: after upgrading, the Free route stays off until it is enabled in advanced settings. Sessions that selected a `DSH OpenCode Free` model before the upgrade need to select a Go model or enable Free first.

The default official gateway lists models at `GET https://opencode.ai/inference/go/v1/models` and reads usage at `GET https://opencode.ai/inference/go/v1/usage`. Inference follows each model's declared protocol and the [official endpoint documentation](https://opencode.ai/v2/docs/console/go/#endpoints). The following paths share the prefix `https://opencode.ai/inference/go`:

| Model protocol | Inference path |
| --- | --- |
| OpenAI Chat Completions, such as GLM-5.3-Flash | `/openai/v1/chat/completions` |
| OpenAI Responses, such as Grok 4.7 and GPT 6 Luna | `/openai/v1/responses` |
| Anthropic Messages, such as Claude Haiku 5.5 | `/anthropic/v1/messages` |
| Google, such as Gemini 4 Argon Contributor | `/google/v1beta/models/{model}:streamGenerateContent` |

The legacy official base `https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1` migrates automatically, and settings writes store the new address. There is no need to change the gateway for each model. Custom gateways keep the configured `baseURL` prefix and let each protocol SDK append its resource path; official protocol segments are not added automatically. A working listing does not verify every inference route.

Usage failures retain the HTTP status and show a redacted summary when the upstream provides a readable reason. HTTP 403 includes a reminder to check the API key and Go subscription permissions. “Key saved” only confirms local credential storage; check the subscription for the account or workspace that owns the key, along with the gateway and proxy settings.

Image offloading keeps the original attachment and replaces the old image in the request with a text placeholder. Raising the limit does not automatically restore previously offloaded images.

Image count overflow is detected before attachment reads. Each request prepares at most four images concurrently and stops when known encoded bytes exceed its payload budget. There is no plugin-wide image queue or shared payload pool.


A cold catalog outage reports `DISCOVERY_FAILED`; a warm catalog retains previously verified models. Only an explicit empty gateway listing clears membership. A partially malformed listing keeps its valid models and reports the ignored row count in settings and logs. Ordinary advanced form settings commit in one revision-checked batch. Credentials use a separate service; failed credential drafts remain, and retry submits only uncommitted parts.

Request failures retain HTTP classification, redacted upstream summaries and applicable context-capacity hints. The plugin no longer writes internal diagnostic files or per-call traces.

## Account operations and saving

Account operations run in a host-owned memory queue, with credential writes completed before settings updates. Closing the page does not cancel a storage write already in progress. There is no transaction journal or startup recovery loop; retry an unsuccessful operation from the accounts card.

Reset all to defaults in advanced settings removes overrides at the current layer and restores inherited values; save to apply the reset. It does not remove accounts or keys, or clear model limit overrides.

## 高级用法

### Headless 模式

安装插件：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile headless add dsh-opencode-go
```

将以下内容保存为 `headless.patch.yml`：

```yaml
- id: agent-default-model
  config:
    provider: dsh-opencode-go
    model: deepseek-v4.1-flash
```

在 Bash 或 Zsh 中输入 Key 后运行任务：

```sh
read -s OPENCODE_API_KEY
export OPENCODE_API_KEY
dsh --profile headless --patch ./headless.patch.yml "你好"
```

将 `model` 换成设置页中可用的模型 ID。示例文件见 [examples/headless.patch.yml](../examples/headless.patch.yml)。

### 网络代理

在 **设置 → OpenCode Go → 高级设置 → 代理地址** 中填写并保存，例如：

```text
http://127.0.0.1:7890
socks5://127.0.0.1:1080
```

支持 HTTP、HTTPS、SOCKS5 和带用户名、密码的代理 URL。保存后，后续对话、模型目录更新和用量查询使用新代理。代理运行在 DSH 所在的机器上；远程部署中的 `127.0.0.1` 指服务器自身。

### 双路由与手动配置

`dsh-opencode-go`（DSH OpenCode Go）从 `baseURL` 的 `/models` 动态发现全部聊天模型，需要至少一个可用 API Key 才激活。`dsh-opencode-free`（DSH OpenCode Free）从 `freeBaseURL` 的 `/models` 筛选已声明合法价格、且文本输入、输出、缓存及所有上下文阶梯均为零的聊天模型；缺失或非法价格不会被视为免费。Free 是**默认关闭的显式 opt-in**：需在 **设置 → OpenCode Go → 高级设置 → 免费通道** 打开（或配置 `freeEnabled: true`）后，插件才会注册 Free 路由、拉取 Free 目录并在设置与模型发现中显示 Free 模型；默认配置下不会访问 `freeBaseURL`。关闭该开关并保存后 Free 路由立即撤回，进行中的请求允许完成；Go 通道行为不变。

Free 共用账号列表，但**已存 Key 与端点绑定**：只有 `freeBaseURL` 是官方 HTTPS 端点（hostname 为 `opencode.ai`、协议为 `https:` 且使用默认端口），或与当前 `baseURL` 同 origin（协议 + 主机 + 端口完全一致，例如自建反向代理同时承载两个路由）时，才复用已存账号 Key 并遵循多账号自动切换设置；`http://opencode.ai`、自定义端口的 `opencode.ai` 以及其它自定义 `freeBaseURL` 一律退回匿名公共访问（`Bearer public`），不读取也不发送任何已存 Key，并产生不含密钥的 info/debug 诊断。两个路由分别保留原始模型 ID，同名模型可同时存在。设置页顶部的两个模型 Tab 分别编辑各自列表；Go 沿用原 ID 设置键，Free 使用 `dsh-opencode-free/<模型 ID>`。

Free 推理通过插件附带的独立 Bun 1.4.4 HTTP worker 直接发送 API 请求；不依赖本机 OpenCode。模型发现、消息和工具转换、响应解析仍由现有 Node SDK 负责，Go 沿用原传输。Free 使用实测的 `opencode/latest/2.2.5/cli` UA（即官方 OpenCode CLI 身份，而非 DSH 自身的归属 UA），并沿用宿主会话 ID 的原有规范化：常见可打印 ASCII 会话 ID 原样透传，仅非可打印 ASCII 或占用插件内部保留前缀的 ID 才做 sha256 + base64url 单向散列（两种形式都不含对话正文）；不注入占位工具或抓包中的账号、项目和会话值。这些兼容行为不保证上游开放免费服务。

> ⚠️ **风险**：Free 通道默认关闭且不是受支持的稳定能力。开启后请求会以官方 CLI 身份发往平台公共免费入口，可能违反 OpenCode / 上游服务条款，也可能触发上游风控、限流或账号限制；是否开启以及使用频度由用户自行判断并自行承担风险，不建议用于生产环境或大规模自动化调用。

Free 请求自动处理限流：`FreeUsageLimitError` 返回 `FREE_QUOTA`，普通 429 返回 `FREE_RATE_LIMIT`，明确的 OpenCode 客户端限制返回 `FREE_CLIENT_RESTRICTED`，其他未明确分类的 403 返回 `FREE_ACCESS_DENIED`。Go 的错误码和账号切换保持原有规则；Free 中明确的 Go 账号额度或凭据错误仍可按既有设置切换账号，共享 Free 限制不会换号或回退到付费 Go。

对共享免费限制及网络、超时、服务端错误，优先遵循 `Retry-After` 秒数或 HTTP 日期（不会把数小时的退避缩短成几分钟）；没有有效头时，从 60 秒开始指数退避，最多 15 分钟。冷却按免费网关与代理配置隔离，冷却期间新调用返回 `FREE_COOLDOWN`，不发送推理请求，也不自动定时重试。到期后可由用户重试；成功请求重置本地退避计数。退避计数只保存在当前插件实例内，重启后清空。

Bun 1.4.4 通过插件直接声明的 `@oven/bun-<platform>` npm 可选平台包安装。平台包直接携带原生二进制，不使用 `bun` 包装包，也没有安装脚本，因此 pnpm 不会要求批准 Bun 的 `postinstall`。包管理器根据系统、CPU 和 libc 选择对应包；若运行时不可用（例如可选依赖被 `--omit=optional` 省略或安装失败），Free 会报告 `MISSING_BUN_RUNTIME`，可重新安装插件并启用 optional dependencies；Go 通道不受影响。Free 默认关闭不会自动省略可选运行时下载。当前支持的系统和 CPU 以这些 Bun 官方平台包为准。

每个 Free HTTP 请求使用一个 worker，默认最多并发 4 个，其余请求可排队或取消。请求通过标准输入传递，响应头和原始 SSE 字节通过标准输出返回；Key 不进入命令行参数或临时文件。消费者停止、超时、取消或卸载插件都会终止相关请求并回收 worker。单个请求体上限为 64 MiB，base64 编码后的 worker IPC 包上限为 256 MiB；worker 自身在读取 stdin 时也会累计校验该包上限。HTTP/HTTPS 代理由 Bun 连接；SOCKS5 使用该请求专属、带随机认证凭据的本机字节隧道，中继只允许连接本次请求的目标 host（大小写不敏感、IP 规范化比较），对无数据往来的连接按本次请求的流空闲预算加 30 秒余量设空闲超时（默认 330 秒），使排队或大上下文 prefill 的静默先由插件自身判定为流空闲超时；目标 TLS 握手仍由 Bun 完成。代理失败不会回退到直连。

协议、能力、思考控制与价格直接来自各自的 `/models` 条目。官方网关优先使用条目声明的协议地址；自定义网关保留配置的前缀。两个模型源分别缓存到 `~/.dsh/cache/dsh-opencode-go/go.models.json` 与 `free.models.json`，支持 ETag 与离线保留；缓存带有网关来源标记，不会用于其他地址。

在 patch 文件中添加 `opencode-go` 配置块，可与上面的默认模型配置一起使用：

```yaml
- id: opencode-go
  config:
    apiKeyEnv: OPENCODE_API_KEY
    accounts:
      - id: primary
        name: 主账号
        apiKeyEnv: OPENCODE_API_KEY
      - id: backup
        name: 备用账号
        apiKeyEnv: OPENCODE_GO_BACKUP_KEY
    autoSwitch: true
    # Free 默认关闭；需要平台免费模型时显式开启（等同于 高级设置 → 免费通道）
    freeEnabled: true
    freeBaseURL: https://opencode.ai/inference/v1
    proxyURL: http://127.0.0.1:7890
    refreshMinutes: 60
    modelVisibility:
      deepseek-v4-pro: false
    modelLimits:
      dsh-opencode-free/beam-free:
        maxTokens: 8192
      deepseek-v4.1-flash:
        maxTokens: 8192
      qwen3.7-plus:
        thinkingBudgets: [4096, 6000]
    maxImages: 30
```

首次查询目录失败会报告 `DISCOVERY_FAILED`；已有目录时保留之前确认过的模型。网关明确返回空列表才会清空目录。列表中仅部分行格式错误时，仍可使用有效模型，设置页与日志会提示被忽略的行数。高级表单的普通配置项一次提交并检查版本；凭据由独立服务保存，凭据保存失败时保留其草稿，重试只提交未成功的部分。

请求失败时，错误信息仍包含 HTTP 分类、脱敏后的上游摘要，以及适用的上下文容量提示。插件不再输出内部诊断文件或逐调用追踪。

账号操作按宿主内存队列顺序执行，凭据写入完成后再更新设置。页面中断不会取消已经开始的存储写入；进程重启后没有事务日志或自动恢复循环，未成功的操作可从账号卡片重新执行。

The page keeps text drafts until Save, model capacities stay typed objects throughout editing, and immediate switches retain their existing behavior. The accounts card owns all credential entry and replacement.

Account commands and automatic primary-account promotion share one in-memory serial queue. Credential writes settle before the next command starts. Metadata changes use a single revision-guarded write; no WAL, startup recovery or conflict retry loop is maintained. Only credentials owned by the removed generated account are deleted. Request generations prevent late fallback outcomes from replacing a newer user selection. Credential, quota and rate-limit failures can try the next account only before output or positive usage, and rejected gateway keys cool down for five minutes. Changing a key or explicitly selecting an account clears its rejection state.

Analytics requests `https://opencode.ai/console/api/v2/usage/export?range=7d|30d|90d` from the Host with the selected account's key. One daily CSV snapshot supplies totals, UTC daily buckets and provider/model detail. Today filters the 7-day snapshot to the current UTC date; absent dates are filled with zero. Input, output, cache read and both 5-minute/1-hour cache-write fields are summed without repricing. Integer `cost_micro_cents` use `1 USD = 100,000,000` units and are presented as the official usage amount, which does not establish extra Go charges.

History queries occur only on open, account/range changes and manual refresh. Official reports and CSVs have a 30-second Host cache isolated by credential, account, network configuration, range and UTC date; forced refresh bypasses it. Queries retain the configured proxy path, cancellation, timeouts and response-size limits. Only official gateway configurations may send keys to Console. Third-party gateways, permission failures, network failures and invalid data produce explicit errors, without a local-history fallback.

The browser receives only aggregate numbers and provider/model/day groups. The user's explicit CSV download may contain official member fields. The independent viewing-account selector defaults to the inference account and scopes all three dashboard quota windows to the selected workspace, including other clients; anonymous Free coverage is not guaranteed.

Settings, the dashboard, pill and expanded sidebar share the same component layouts and internal `--go-*` token contract. `appearanceTheme` selects `native` (the default) or `classic`; existing profiles without the field also resolve to Native. Both themes use the Host's light/dark scheme. Native resolves colors, typography, radii, elevation and focus metrics through public Host semantic tokens, allowing DSH and third-party themes to propagate across every plugin surface, and uses neutral fallbacks for unresolved tokens. Every quota bar track uses one derived `--go-track` property: `QUOTA_TRACK_PERCENT` of the theme's text color mixed into the backdrop, instead of a Host surface layer. Native light's layer-2 can be the card's own colour (1.0:1 in the default Host palette; about 1.1:1 against the neutral fallback surface), so a surface-colored track left the bar's fill floating with no frame — the reported 1% reading was a stray dot. The mix keeps the track near 1.4:1 against light surfaces and 1.7:1 in dark; in the checked Native/Classic fallback palettes the fill stays at least 2.5:1 against the track (Native's accent follows the Host, so a third-party accent is not covered by that bound). `theme.client.spec.ts` composites exactly that percentage and asserts every quota track rule paints the token. The row bar stays one continuous track: its former 1px surface-coloured quarter marks are gone, because on a visible track they read as gaps that split one bar into four. Native's strong control boundary and its state-derived chart series (output, cache read, cache write) deliberately keep checked local values instead of following the Host palette: the Host's `border-l2` is a hairline divider and its `state-*` colors are status dots, neither contrast-managed for control boundaries or data-viz, so following them would break the plugin's WCAG 1.4.11 3:1 contract. The brand-accent chart series still follows the Host accent. Classic instead keeps its own warm paper/charcoal, terracotta and serif token sets, independent of Host and third-party theme overrides. Classic typography prefers locally installed Anthropic Serif Web, Sans Web and Mono Web families, with system fallbacks and CJK serif headings; no font binaries or external font requests are added.

Theme selection changes token resolution rather than component layout. Styling stays within plugin-owned components and the shared token layer; overrides that reached into Host-private styles have been removed instead of depending on undocumented Host internals. `usagePillStyle` still supports `badge` (default) and `plain`, while `showSidebarQuota` remains an independent switch, off by default.

Backend history tests use synthetic CSVs, synthetic keys and loopback services; real user keys are not used in automated tests. The separately recorded Console check establishes source availability for the checked account; automated migration results are recorded separately in the verification notes.

Image count limits are checked before reads. Each request prepares up to four images concurrently and checks its own encoded-payload budget. The host's `requiredImageOffload` / `projectOffloadedImages` protocol owns durable offload marks. There is no plugin-wide preparation queue or payload pool. HTTP failure classification, credential redaction, context-capacity hints, stream deadlines and cancellation remain active; internal call tracing and diagnostic file capture are removed.

## Publishing

`npm publish` is guarded by two lifecycle hooks. `prepack` re-runs `npm run check:dist`, so a stale `lib/` fails before a tarball is produced; `prepublishOnly` runs `npm run typecheck && npm run test:ci` (artifact comparison plus the complete Vitest suite). `verify:installed` is deliberately absent from both hooks because it needs a consumer installation; run it separately before a release when one is available. `check:install:pnpm` is likewise outside the lifecycle hooks because it downloads pnpm and installs the tarball; its dedicated CI job is blocking. `npm run check:pack` (also a CI step) runs `npm pack --dry-run --json --ignore-scripts` and asserts the tarball contains the runtime entries, types, docs, examples, icons and third-party notice files. `lib/build-info.json` records the package version, so bumping `package.json` requires rebuilding `lib/` before release. The tarball ships `scripts/licenses/pi-1.5.0-LICENSE` next to `lib/vendor-licenses.txt` so the reference in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` resolves inside the installed package. `CHANGELOG.md` and `SECURITY.md` are part of the tarball as well, so release notes and the security policy install with the package. The current release line is `0.4.0`; its minor bump carries Native and Classic UI themes, compact settings page, and Gemini unsigned tool-history replay compatibility. `npm run check:hygiene` runs inside `verify`, so CI enforces source hygiene without a separate workflow step.

# Independent package decision

The plugin owns its Host adapter, Web settings entry, build, package manifest, activation layer, and tests. It consumes DSH through published npm exports. The source tree and build have no reference to a DSH checkout.

The Host depends on DSH services through peer dependencies so Cordis service classes and LLM error identities remain shared with the application; the two DSH utility packages the Host imports, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-brand` and `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`, are peers for the same reason. The Client resolves React, the store, and UI primitives through the DSH module table. UI type packages are optional peers because headless installations do not mount those services; this project's development dependencies supply the types and test runtime libraries.

The package's bundle keeps the configuration entry `id: opencode-go` so existing settings remain attached. Its LLM provider route is independently named `dsh-opencode-go`, shown as `DSH OpenCode Go`, and can coexist with the generic adapter's `opencode-go` route. The SDK retains its native `opencode-go` identity for transport behavior; replay metadata records the DSH route and an optional `sdkProvider` to restore the native identity. The original fork's `llm-opencode-go` row can be disabled by a profile patch. Plugin registration does not select the user's default model or replace another provider automatically. Saved session/preset provider selections must be updated explicitly.

The plugin owns request-history, stream and replay conversion in `src/conversion.ts`, with the upstream MIT license. It consumes only published host APIs from DSH `0.2.1-rc.5` and later. Protocol transport remains implemented by the pinned private pi-ai SDK, with Google adapter wrappers in `src/google.ts` and the request-local fetch binding in `src/transport.ts`.

The build uses esbuild and lightningcss, with Rollup to flatten the exported SDK declarations. The host bundles the required pi-ai implementation and only the OpenCode Go model catalog. DSH services, Undici, OpenAI and Anthropic SDKs stay external; DSH class identities remain shared. The browser factory follows DSH's `window.__ModuleLoader__.load` format, embeds CSS Modules, and allows only the declared platform module imports. A package-level builder is sufficient for this single external plugin; extracting a general DSH build-tool package would require a separate release and is not a prerequisite for installation.

The minimum supported Host is DSH `0.2.1-rc.5`, with Cordis `^4.0.5`. `@deepseek-ai/dsh-brand` (`>=0.2.1-rc.5`) and `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` (`>=3.18.5 <4`) are peer dependencies supplied by the Host installation rather than dependencies installed by the plugin, so a profile keeps one copy of each even when the application ships a newer DSH release. Development dependencies and the lockfile pin the DSH `0.2.1-rc.5` release, Cordis `4.0.5` and Schemastery `3.18.5`. Consumer installation uses the prebuilt artifacts and does not run a plugin build. Releases are guarded: `prepack` re-runs `check:dist`, `prepublishOnly` runs the type checks plus the artifact/tests gate, and `check:pack` (also a CI step) asserts the tarball contents. `lib/build-info.json` records the package version, and the tarball ships `scripts/licenses/pi-1.5.0-LICENSE` with the third-party licenses so the notice reference resolves inside the package; `CHANGELOG.md` and `SECURITY.md` ship with it as well. The current release line is `0.4.0`, whose minor bump carries Native and Classic UI themes, compact settings page, and Gemini unsigned tool-history replay compatibility. `check:hygiene` in the `verify` chain keeps tracked sources UTF-8/LF/trailing-whitespace clean. Development dependencies are not pruned: DSH client packages import dependencies their own manifests do not declare (for example `clsx`, `shiki`/`@shikijs/langs`, `katex`, the markdown/micromark chain, `zustand`/`immer`, `simple-icons` and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-util-workspace-path`), so the root development dependencies remain the only supply for those implicit runtime and type imports and a clean `npm ci` is the reliable verification.

Verification uses 21 domain-focused Vitest files against published rc.5 APIs, separate host/client type checks, a byte-for-byte independent rebuild and Cordis's ordinary package resolver. The suite imports the current 25 implementation modules directly. `npm run verify:installed -- /path/to/consumer` exercises a consumer's resolved package; `npm run verify:headless -- /path/to/consumer` additionally exercises the official CLI with a temporary profile and loopback gateway. The default `verify` includes the complete test suite. See [development](development.md) and [verification](verification.md) for commands and scope.

# Usage analytics notes

The dashboard shows official history for the workspace belonging to the selected OpenCode key. It can include calls from other clients and does not attribute calls to this plugin. Coverage of anonymous Free calls is not guaranteed.

## Entry points and accounts

Open it from the conversation's expanded usage pill or the sidebar dashboard button. Settings no longer include a usage analytics card; the interface theme picker is under **Settings → OpenCode Go → Advanced settings → Usage settings → Appearance**.

The dashboard has an independent viewing-account selector, defaulting to the account currently used for inference. Changing it only changes the dashboard scope; it does not switch the account for subsequent conversations or combine all saved accounts. The dashboard's five-hour, weekly and monthly quota windows follow the selected account and use official quota percentages.

## Official data source

The Host uses the selected account's key to request the official daily CSV:

```text
https://opencode.ai/console/api/v2/usage/export?range=7d|30d|90d
```

Totals, daily charts and model detail all come from one CSV snapshot, avoiding differences between endpoints queried at different times. Ranges are today, 7 days, 30 days and 90 days; today filters the 7-day CSV to the current UTC date. All dates use UTC, with missing dates filled with zero to keep the daily series continuous. Official daily aggregates may be delayed, so refreshing may not immediately include a recently completed call.

The Host stores and uses keys. Normal reports send the browser only aggregate numbers and grouping fields such as provider, model and day, without conversation content, member fields or keys. An official CSV explicitly downloaded by the user may contain official member fields.

History queries require an official model gateway configuration before the Host sends a key to the `opencode.ai` Console. Third-party gateways show an unsupported state and their keys are not sent to Console. Queries retain the configured proxy path, cancellation, timeouts and response-size limits.

| Requests | Sum of official CSV request counts |
| Input / output tokens | Official input and output fields, summed separately |
| Cache-read tokens | Sum of the official cache-read field |
| Cache-write tokens | Sum of official 5-minute and 1-hour cache-write fields |
| Total tokens | Input + output + cache read + both cache-write fields |
| Official usage amount | Exact sum of `cost_micro_cents`; `1 USD = 100,000,000 cost_micro_cents` |
| Model grouping | Provider + model; identical model names from different providers stay separate |

The amount comes directly from official records and is labeled **official usage amount**. It does not mean an additional charge beyond the Go subscription. The dashboard does not reprice history using the current model catalog or derive quota percentages from amounts.

Only source-supported metrics are shown. Local session coverage, summary-call counts, unsettled attempts and unattributed activity are not reported or filled with misleading zeros. UTC zero-filling only means the official CSV contains no records for that day.

## Presentation and refresh

- A wide-screen dialog becomes full-screen on narrow screens, with stacked daily token bars or daily request bars, model rankings and detail.
- Settings, the pill, expanded sidebar and dashboard share component layouts and internal tokens, following the Host's light/dark mode. `appearanceTheme: native` (the default) follows DSH and third-party themes through public Host semantic tokens for colors, fonts, radii and more, with neutral fallbacks for unresolved tokens. `classic` retains warm paper / charcoal surfaces, terracotta accents, and preferred local Anthropic Serif / Sans / Mono fonts with system and CJK serif fallbacks; Host and third-party themes do not override these brand tokens. Existing profiles without the field default to Native, while the input's `badge` / `plain` styles and the sidebar quota switch keep their existing behavior.
- History queries run only when opening the dashboard, changing the viewing account or range, or refreshing manually. There is no background history polling; closing the dashboard cancels its active query.
- The Host caches official reports and CSVs for 30 seconds, isolated by credential, account, network configuration, range and UTC date. A forced manual refresh bypasses the cache.
- Authentication, permission, network and data-format errors show an explicit failure, without falling back to local session scans or fabricated zero usage.

The usage pill's existing quota refresh is independent of history queries.

# 用量统计说明

[返回 README](../README.md) · [English](usage-analytics.en.md)

用量看板展示所选 OpenCode Key 所属工作区的官方历史用量。数据可能包含其他客户端的调用，不能据此判断某次调用来自本插件；匿名 Free 调用的覆盖不作保证。

## 入口与账号

从对话用量胶囊展开后的看板按钮，或侧栏看板按钮打开。设置页不再提供用量统计卡片；界面主题选择器位于 **设置 → OpenCode Go → 高级设置 → 用量设置 → 外观**。

看板有独立的查看账号选择器，默认选择当前调用账号。切换查看账号只改变看板范围，不会切换后续对话使用的账号，也不会合并所有已保存账号。看板内的 5 小时、每周、每月额度窗口均跟随所选账号，百分比以官方额度接口为准。

## 官方数据来源

Host 使用所选账号的 Key 请求官方每日 CSV：

```text
https://opencode.ai/console/api/v2/usage/export?range=7d|30d|90d
```

一份报告的总计、每日图表与模型明细都从同一个 CSV 快照生成，避免多个接口在不同时间返回数据造成差异。支持今日、7 天、30 天、90 天；「今日」从 7 天 CSV 中筛选 UTC 当日。日期统一按 UTC，区间内缺少记录的日期补零，保持日序列连续。官方每日汇总可能延迟，刷新不保证立即看到刚结束的调用。

Key 由 Host 保存并使用。常规报告只向浏览器传递聚合数字，以及 provider、model、day 等分组字段，不含会话正文、成员字段或 Key。用户主动下载官方 CSV 时，文件可包含官方导出的成员字段。

只有官方模型网关配置支持历史查询，Host 才会将 Key 发给 `opencode.ai` Console。第三方网关配置显示不支持，不会把其 Key 发送到 Console。查询沿用已配置的代理路径，并保留取消、超时和响应体大小限制。

## 统计口径

| 项目 | 口径 |
| --- | --- |
| 请求数 | 汇总 CSV 的官方请求数 |
| 输入 / 输出 Token | 分别汇总官方输入、输出字段 |
| 缓存读 Token | 汇总官方 cache-read 字段 |
| 缓存写 Token | 合计官方 5 分钟与 1 小时 cache-write 字段 |
| 总 Token | 输入 + 输出 + 缓存读 + 两类缓存写 |
| 官方用量金额 | 精确累加 `cost_micro_cents`；`1 USD = 100,000,000 cost_micro_cents` |
| 模型分组 | 使用 provider + model；不同 provider 的同名模型分别统计 |

金额直接来自官方记录，称为「官方用量金额」，不等同于 Go 套餐之外的额外扣款。看板不使用当前模型价目表重算历史费用，也不根据金额反推订阅额度百分比。

只有来源能够支持的数据才会显示。看板不提供本地会话覆盖、摘要调用、未结算尝试或未归属活动等指标，也不会用零值代替这些未知数据。UTC 补零仅表示官方 CSV 在该日没有记录。

## 展示与刷新

- 看板在宽屏使用弹窗，窄屏使用全屏；提供 Token 堆叠日柱图或请求日柱图、模型排行与明细。
- 设置页、胶囊、展开侧栏和看板共用布局与内部 token，并跟随宿主明暗模式。`appearanceTheme: native`（默认）通过 Host 公开语义 token 跟随 DSH 和第三方主题的颜色、字体、圆角等，无法解析时使用中性 fallback；`classic` 保留暖纸色 / 炭灰色、陶土色强调及本地 Anthropic Serif / Sans / Mono、中文衬线回退，不跟随 Host 或第三方主题覆盖这些品牌 token。未设置该字段的旧配置缺省使用 Native；输入栏 `badge` / `plain` 样式和侧栏额度开关行为不变。
- 历史只在打开看板、切换查看账号、切换区间或手动刷新时查询，不后台轮询。关闭看板会取消正在进行的查询。
- Host 对官方报告与 CSV 使用 30 秒短缓存，按凭证、账号、网络配置、区间与 UTC 日期隔离；手动强制刷新绕过缓存。
- 鉴权、权限、网络或数据格式错误明确显示失败，不回退到本地会话扫描，也不显示伪造的零用量。

额度胶囊原有的额度刷新与历史查询相互独立。

## Regression scope

The test files import current modules directly, without resolver aliases or temporary path substitutions. Support helpers provide current host/account services, ConfigForm/React fixtures, offline model data, loopback gateways and proxies. Tests for removed journals, recovery state machines, diagnostic capture, global image pools and legacy host APIs are removed.

The pre-migration baseline covered:

- Real Cordis/Loader lifecycle, native SettingsForms and owner-scoped RPC, hot profile changes without adapter remounts, coexistence with the native provider and durable signed continuations.
- Account CRUD, generated-key ownership, the 20-account limit, queue serialization across reconnects, failed-write cleanup, read-only keys, stale operations and primary promotion. Real HTTP 401/403/429 and quota responses verify fallback before output, cooldown/expiry, cancellation and prevention of replay after output or charged usage.
- Model catalog discovery, missing/invalid metadata, online refresh and ETag/disk caching, endpoint isolation, lifecycle visibility, typed capacities, request snapshots, reasoning choices and OpenAI/Anthropic/Google wire behavior.
- Stable session and attribution headers, stream outcomes/deadlines, independent tool-role conversion, replay signatures, image offload projection, exact encoded-byte/count budgets and request-local preparation concurrency.
- Official quota/error codecs. Official-history CSV behavior is covered by the migration checks above.
- Bounded JSON/gzip responses, safe gateway classification/redaction, actual HTTP CONNECT and SOCKS5 proxy paths, concurrent Google fetch binding and version-guarded SDK patch matching.
- Free-specific quota/client/access/rate-limit classification, Retry-After seconds and HTTP dates including clock skew, bounded exponential fallback, endpoint/proxy isolation, concurrent completion ordering and zero inference during cooldown. A normal Host request test limits Free and then completes Go streaming with its saved fixture key in the same mount.
- Settings Save/Reset/Discard and rejected/concurrent writes; AccountsCard additions, quota states, row actions and drag/keyboard sorting; model editor/search/visibility and refresh races; quota pill polling, account switching and retained readings; installed locale resolution and live Chinese/English changes. Dashboard and palette migration checks are listed separately above.

Test-hardening batch (2026-11-09):

- Free saved-key reuse is restricted to the official HTTPS endpoint on its default port. Plain-HTTP, re-ported and look-alike official hosts fall back to `Bearer public` without reading or sending saved keys; the binding matrix covers positive and negative official-host spellings.
- The loopback SOCKS relay's idle limit is derived from the configured stream idle budget plus a margin and resets while bytes flow, so a relay teardown cannot pre-empt the plugin's own `LLM_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT` classification and Free cooldown semantics. The adapter forwarding of the per-request budget to the transport is itself covered, so the derivation cannot be bypassed by dropping the argument.
- Chart contrast assertions now also composite the rendered 88% bar opacity on top of the raw-token checks; the Classic light cache-read and cache-write series are checked against their actual blended color on every surface, and the opacity used in the math is published as a style token and cross-checked against the stylesheet.
- The focused-chart Escape precedence is exercised with a really focused bar (focus-only activation, pinned day and non-chart focus), replacing dispatches to unfocused elements, and the settings page test now asserts dashboard absence without the stale "theme selection is absent" claim.

## Isolation and limits

Vitest gives each test a temporary `DSH_HOME`, serves complete synthetic `/models` declarations, uses loopback gateways/proxies and rejects other network requests. The installed-package smoke also uses a temporary home, synthetic credentials and metadata, and loopback inference. It resolves the built package through the consumer's ordinary Cordis resolver and verifies dual route discovery, streamed text, session headers, attribution, authorization and unload.

The pinned rc.5 UI primitives package references an unpublished `index.js.map`; Vite reports a non-fatal source-map warning. Undici also reports its experimental SOCKS5 notice during the real proxy test. Neither creates a failed test or nonzero command exit. The suite does not filter these messages or patch installed packages.

JSDOM verifies DOM interactions and accessible state. Its static ResizeObserver fixture does not establish browser layout geometry or production latency; the real-browser preview checks above cover the recorded layouts. Loopback inference does not establish live gateway availability or paid model behavior. `npm run verify:headless -- /path/to/consumer` remains available for a consumer containing the official CLI; it is separate from the default acceptance path.

The installed Harness CLI loaded the rebuilt package from an isolated `DSH_HOME`: Go completed one loopback request with the expected synthetic credential and session header (exit 0). A single public `beam-free` request to the real Free gateway returned HTTP 429 / `FreeUsageLimitError`, now surfaced as `FREE_QUOTA` (exit 1, expected upstream rejection). This validates error propagation, not live Free availability; no paid upstream inference was used. The 53,305-second backoff and Go coexistence were verified with deterministic HTTP/RPC fixtures.
